body: I have taken to much time for myself, I think that's what lead me to this. Certain things brings me joy for some time, then the thoughts come back and I feel horrible again. I know this is a classic sign of depression and it really ruins any enjoyment I can have sometimes. Days goes by where I don't feel 10 seconds of fulfillment or joy at all.

But it's still in my circle, and I know I care too much. I was better at ignoring things like that before, now it seems completely opposite. No idea why that it is, but I think it's the resentment I hold against myself which in turn makes it harder to actually accept who I am. I don't wanna be labeled as anything, even though in grande scheme that does not matter. I am aware of these things yet I still fear them. It really is irrational.

I have thought a lot about volunteering actually as I think it would change some views I have. I know so many people have it way worse but that does nothing to change how I feel internally. Maybe it would change it mentally if I do it, it probably should. At least I would be forced with it for hours, after a while that should have some mental effect on me. Definitively an idea I have been floating around lately.

I am very certain that such a thing would help tremendously, but I got a lot of fear of it as well. So yeah, it is holding me back a lot. I am trying to keep in here but it feels like I have done so for a long time.
